title: Mahj Mondays at the Gillioz
seo_title: Mahj Mondays at the Gillioz in Springfield, MO
description: Mahj Mondays are open play nights for American Mahjong in The Gallery at the Gillioz Theatre, held with Blooming Bams. It is for players who already know American Mahjong (NMJL rules) at any skill level; bring your own 2026 NMJL card, and tile sets are provided or you can bring your own. Free, drop in or stay the whole time on Monday, December 7, 2026, 5:30 to 8:30 PM at 325 Park Central E., Springfield, MO.
venue: The Gallery at the Gillioz Theatre

organizer.name: The Gallery at the Gillioz in collaboration with Blooming Bams
